svg.title: Newport, PA: scouting map for the new Millbrook
svg.text: Candidate for the new Millbrook (decision U25); population 1470
Map: 4 km square, UTM zone 18N (EPSG:32618); north up

through the south of the borough)
Bridges: 1 road bridge(s) over the river in the 1 km square, 1
in 2 km, 2 on the map; 4 over streams

from the centre; active railway 12.7 km on the map
Landing: add: boat launch by the bridge
Farms: barn, outside the 2 km square, 1.5 km from the centre
Wetland: add: marsh on the river bottom
Woods roads: track, in the 2 km square, 1.0 km from the centre
